metadata.status: proposed; not yet merged into lesson-dag.json

nodes.title: Baire category and the three Banach mapping theorems
nodes.why: Prove (not simply cite) bounded inverse/open mapping, closed graph and uniform boundedness; distinguish theorem prerequisites.

nodes.title: Rank factorization and uniqueness of positive Gram factorizations
nodes.why: Construct factorization and isometries explicitly, including kernels, rank and zero cases.

nodes.title: Moore–Penrose inverse and the four Penrose equations
nodes.why: Develop from singular systems, including noninvertible rectangular examples and proof of uniqueness.

nodes.title: Doubly stochastic matrices, Birkhoff and Schur–Horn
nodes.why: Prove convex combination and diagonal-majorization mechanisms used in spectral norm inequalities.

nodes.title: Karamata and complete Fan-dominance argument
nodes.why: Prove propagation from singular-value weak majorization to general unitary-invariant seminorms.

nodes.title: Hoffman–Wielandt and Davis eigenvalue-change bounds
nodes.why: Prove squared eigenvalue differences and matching/permutation controls.

nodes.title: Hilbert–Schmidt operators as a Hilbert space and basis independence
nodes.why: Construct the column ℓ² model and justify basis independence and infinite sums.

nodes.title: Fourier transform, inverse transforms, Laplace integrals and Fubini
nodes.why: Establish transform conventions, inversion and integrability theorems from examples.

nodes.title: Poisson summation and odd-pole expansion for the reciprocal kernel
nodes.why: Derive the lattice identity and exact positive integral needed by the π/2 mass.

nodes.title: Haagerup–Zsidó reciprocal kernel, transform identity and exact π/2 mass
nodes.why: Reconstruct SSP-A01–A26, in particular integrability, transform and mass.

nodes.title: Bochner integration of operator-valued functions and norm bounds
nodes.why: Prove operator-valued integration and interchange of bounded maps with integrals.

nodes.title: Coercive forms, Lax–Milgram and the ordered Sylvester inverse
nodes.why: Derive coercive inverse estimates and show which gap geometry provides coercivity.

nodes.title: Complex contour calculus and Rosenblum uniqueness
nodes.why: Present contour-based proof and distinguish spectral disjointness from quantitative gap.

nodes.title: Relative boundedness and Kato–Rellich self-adjointness
nodes.why: Control perturbation of unbounded domains, common-domain estimates and self-adjointness.

nodes.title: Cayley transforms, resolvent identities and domain transfer
nodes.why: Follow graph/domain hypotheses through analytic identities; not only formal matrix equalities.

nodes.title: Strong versus norm convergence and dominated spectral cutoff limits
nodes.why: Derive convergence routes preserving domains and projections.

nodes.title: Scalar measure representation, PVM construction and Borel calculus proof
nodes.why: Prove countable additivity, projection algebra and uniqueness rather than stopping at a statement.

nodes.title: Symmetric gauges, finite/infinite approximation and ideal membership
nodes.why: Make the ideal-domain and norm-existence conditions explicit.

nodes.title: Domain-aware Sylvester solution via resolvent and spectral cutoffs
nodes.why: Assemble full closed operator proof with domain preservation, not just bounded estimates.

nodes.title: Measurability of random-matrix eigenvalues and threshold projectors
nodes.why: Proof-level measurability route for statistical applications.

nodes.title: Sample moments, matrix norm comparison and concentration
nodes.why: Prove the probabilistic bounds rather than importing them into the final application.

nodes.title: Generator domain and Stone theorem through the spectral measure
nodes.why: Explain strong continuity, derivative domain and equivalence with self-adjoint generators.

nodes.title: Hardy spaces, Fourier series, Toeplitz and Hankel operators
nodes.why: An independent track, not a compulsory DK prerequisite.

nodes.title: Fredholm operators, compact quotients, C*-algebras, winding
nodes.why: Needs external C*-algebra, operator K-theory and circle-degree supplier audits.

nodes.title: Finite-section method and stable Toeplitz approximation
nodes.why: Study finite-section stability as a separate advanced branch.

proof_spines.title: Finite residual sine-angle bound
proof_spines.proof_task: Derive the residual identity, identify directed sine as a modulus, prove the relevant Sylvester estimate, combine.

proof_spines.title: Sharp pairwise π/2 Sylvester estimate
proof_spines.proof_task: Construct reciprocal kernel, prove Fourier identity and exact mass, integrate conjugates and transfer symmetric gauge bounds.

proof_spines.title: General unbounded and symmetric-ideal sine theorem
proof_spines.proof_task: Track closed domains through residual maps, establish ideal membership/norm and prove the angle-modulus identification.

proof_spines.title: Tangent and doubled-angle families
proof_spines.proof_task: Prove graph/Riccati identities, involution symmetry, branch restrictions and sharpness examples.

proof_spines.title: Direct rotation optimality and countermodel
proof_spines.proof_task: Separate restricted from ambient objectives and verify the four-dimensional counterexample.

proof_spines.title: Matrix spectral statistics proof branch
proof_spines.proof_task: Establish rank factorization, measurable spectral projectors, concentration and statistical gap transfer.

proof_spines.title: Toeplitz and Fredholm extension (not prerequisite to Davis–Kahan)
